lessons.title: Where is…?

items.example: ¿Dónde está la estación?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the station?

items.example: La calle es muy larga.
items.exampleMeaning: The street is very long.

items.example: La plaza está cerca.
items.exampleMeaning: The square is nearby.

items.example: El banco está al lado de la tienda.
items.exampleMeaning: The bank is next to the store.

items.example: Gira a la derecha en la esquina.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn to the right at the corner.

items.example: La tienda está a la izquierda.
items.exampleMeaning: The store is to the left.

lessons.tip: When asking for directions, use '¿Dónde está...?' to find a specific place. Remember to use 'a la derecha' for right and 'a la izquierda' for left.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: El banco está a la derecha.
dialogue.meaning: The bank is to the right.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La calle está a la izquierda.
dialogue.meaning: The street is to the left.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a local person giving directions.
scenario.learnerRole: B is a tourist asking for directions.
scenario.brief: You ask A where the square and the bank are. A responds with directions to each place.
scenario.goal: You should ask for the location of two places.

lessons.title: Giving Directions

items.example: Sigue todo recto.
items.exampleMeaning: Follow straight ahead.

items.example: Gira a la derecha.
items.exampleMeaning: Turn to the right.

items.example: Cruza la calle.
items.exampleMeaning: Cross the street.

items.example: Al final de la calle, está el banco.
items.exampleMeaning: At the end of the street, there is the bank.

items.example: El parque está delante de la plaza.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is in front of the square.

items.example: La tienda está detrás del banco.
items.exampleMeaning: The store is behind the bank.

lessons.tip: When giving directions, use the imperative form. For example, 'Sigue' means 'follow' and is a command.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: What is in front of the square?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: El parque está delante de la plaza.
dialogue.meaning: The park is in front of the square.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a local person giving directions.
scenario.learnerRole: B is a tourist following the directions.
scenario.brief: You ask A for directions to the bank and the square. A gives you clear instructions on how to get there.
scenario.goal: You should understand and follow the directions given.

lessons.title: More Places

items.example: El restaurante está abierto.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is open.

items.example: La tienda está lejos.
items.exampleMeaning: The store is far away.

items.example: El parque es bonito.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is nice.

items.example: El hotel está en la calle principal.
items.exampleMeaning: The hotel is on the main street.

items.example: La biblioteca cierra a las siete.
items.exampleMeaning: The library closes at seven.

items.example: El cine está detrás de la tienda.
items.exampleMeaning: The cinema is behind the store.

lessons.tip: Familiarize yourself with common places in your area. Knowing words like 'restaurante' and 'biblioteca' will help you ask for directions.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: El restaurante está cerca del parque.
dialogue.meaning: The restaurant is near the park.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La biblioteca está en la calle principal.
dialogue.meaning: The library is on the main street.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: El cine está detrás de la tienda.
dialogue.meaning: The cinema is behind the store.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a local person answering questions about places.
scenario.learnerRole: B is a tourist asking about various locations.
scenario.brief: You ask A about the location of a restaurant, library, and cinema. A gives you the directions to each place.
scenario.goal: You should learn the locations of three different places.

lessons.title: Position Words

items.example: El banco está cerca de la plaza.
items.exampleMeaning: The bank is near the square.

items.example: El hotel está lejos de la estación.
items.exampleMeaning: The hotel is far from the station.

items.example: El parque está entre la tienda y el banco.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is between the store and the bank.

items.example: La biblioteca está junto a la plaza.
items.exampleMeaning: The library is next to the square.

items.example: El cine está enfrente de la tienda.
items.exampleMeaning: The cinema is in front of the store.

items.example: El restaurante está dentro del hotel.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is inside the hotel.

lessons.tip: Use position words to describe where something is. For example, 'cerca de' means 'near' and helps you explain locations.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: El cine está enfrente de la tienda.
dialogue.meaning: The cinema is in front of the store.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Está entre la tienda y el banco.
dialogue.meaning: It is between the store and the bank.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a local person giving detailed directions.
scenario.learnerRole: B is a tourist asking about locations and distances.
scenario.brief: You ask A about the locations of the bank, cinema, and park. A gives you directions using position words.
scenario.goal: You should understand the position of three places in relation to each other.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How do I get to the bank?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sigue todo recto y gira a la izquierda.
dialogue.meaning: Follow straight ahead and turn to the left.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: De nada, que tengas un buen día.
dialogue.meaning: You're welcome, have a nice day.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a local person providing directions.
scenario.learnerRole: B is a tourist seeking help with directions.
scenario.brief: You will ask A about the locations of the restaurant, bank, and cinema. A will give you clear directions.
scenario.goal: You should practice asking and understanding directions to different places.
